summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Valuevade Quiz system (QuizStartPage, QuizPage, QuizCompletePage). Seeded a user_enrollment + user_module + user_session for test user (testagent2026@gmail.com) linked to master_session 'Time Value of Money' which has 10 master_quiz_questions. Ran a full pass-flow (1 wrong + 9 correct = 90%). UI/UX, state transitions, testids and routing all work as specified. One CRITICAL integration bug: markPhaseComplete call fails silently because QuizCompletePage sends columns (quiz_total, quiz_attempts, quiz_passed) that do NOT exist on user_sessions table - so quiz_completed is NEVER set to true in Supabase even after passing.

integration_issues.issue: QuizCompletePage.jsx lines 130-138 pass scoreData={quiz_score, quiz_total, quiz_attempts, quiz_passed} into markPhaseComplete → user_sessions UPDATE. Only quiz_score column exists on user_sessions (schema: id, user_module_id, master_session_id, title, description, order_index, is_added_by_ai, is_removed, ai_reasoning, notes_completed, quiz_completed, interview_completed, simulation_completed, is_completed, completed_at, quiz_score, interview_score, simulation_score, quiz_attempts? — NO quiz_total, quiz_passed). Supabase rejects the UPDATE with 400 (unknown column), the error is caught & silently ignored in QuizCompletePage's try/catch. Verified: after completing quiz at 90%, user_sessions row still shows quiz_completed=false, quiz_score=null. This breaks the whole progress pipeline (quiz phase will never be marked DONE on SessionStartPage, module completion will never trigger).

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix column mismatch in QuizCompletePage.jsx. Either (a) add quiz_total/quiz_attempts/quiz_passed columns to user_sessions via Supabase migration, or (b) only send quiz_score (already exists) into markPhaseComplete and derive pass/attempts client-side / in a separate table. Confirmed on live DB: SELECT on user_sessions returns columns notes_completed/quiz_completed/..../quiz_score/interview_score/simulation_score (no quiz_total / quiz_passed / quiz_attempts). quiz_attempts is referenced in QuizCompletePage line 125 — also likely missing.
Improve error reporting in QuizCompletePage save() — the empty `try { ... } catch {}` swallows this real integration failure. At minimum console.error it so QA catches regressions.
Consider warning toast if markPhaseComplete returns {success:false} so user knows their progress didn't persist.
critical_code_review_comments: QuizCompletePage.jsx save() effect line 145 has `catch {}` silently swallowing all DB errors - hides real bugs like the quiz_total/quiz_passed schema mismatch.

QuizCompletePage — saved-guard logic: `if (saved || ...) return` then `finally setSaved(true)` means if any quick remount fires before finally resolves, duplicate inserts possible. Use a ref/abort flag.
markPhaseComplete swallows the unknown-column error inside scoreData - it should either validate allowed keys or let the caller know via returned {success:false,error}. Caller ignores it already.

QuizPage.jsx progress bar formula `(idx + (submitted ? 1 : 0))/total` means final question submitted still shows (total-1+1)/total = 100% only after Submit, but during idx=0 submitted state progress = 1/total = 10% (feels low). Acceptable but consider (idx+1)/total once submitted.
No authoritative retry counter - on Retry, Quiz page resets to idx 0 but quiz_attempts in scoreData computed as (existing+1) only runs on pass path; fail path uses best-effort update - inconsistent.
QuizStartPage calculates estMinutes = Math.max(2, ceil(qCount*1.2)). 10 Q → 12 min. Fine, matches expectation.

detailed_verifications.markPhaseComplete_persistence: FAIL - after 90% pass, user_sessions.quiz_completed still FALSE, quiz_score still NULL. Root cause: update payload contains quiz_total/quiz_passed/quiz_attempts columns that don't exist on the table - PostgREST rejects, error swallowed in try/catch.

rca of the issue: QuizCompletePage.jsx builds scoreData={quiz_score, quiz_total, quiz_attempts, quiz_passed} and passes it to markPhaseComplete which does supabase.from('user_sessions').update(updatePayload). Supabase REST rejects unknown columns with HTTP 400 ('column "quiz_total" of relation "user_sessions" does not exist'). The update is atomic so nothing persists - quiz_completed flag never gets set. Because QuizCompletePage wraps the save() in `try { ... } catch {}` with empty catch, no error is shown/logged. Fix options: (1) add DB columns quiz_total/quiz_attempts/quiz_passed via migration; (2) strip scoreData to existing columns (quiz_score only) and derive passed from score>=70% * total elsewhere; (3) create a separate quiz_attempts table for attempt tracking. Reproduction: login as testagent2026, go to /session/5e0c2a88-d864-4827-9a95-5aedd8d27ffd/quiz, complete at >=70%, query user_sessions row - quiz_completed remains false.
